part1.claim: Apply Sync rebuilds the timeline clean-slate; the freshly minted segments carry no lock state at all, so no lock can reach the timing chain.

part2.claim: applyAnchorBasedTiming honours `locked` — so losing the flag at Part 1 is not cosmetic, it changes the committed timeline.

summary: K13 confirmed live against production code and the real 173 corpus: locks cannot survive Apply Sync (Part 1), and the flag they lose materially changes committed durations (Part 2). C11 therefore checks a demonstrated defect, not an asserted one.
